title.narrative: Regional Health Integration to Enhance Services in South West Uganda (RHITES SW)

description.narrative: (Uganda): RHITES-SW supports 18 districts, with approximately 4.6 million people. While portions of the HIV and TB portfolio have already transitioned to local partners, in its last year, RHITES-SW will support completing the integrated high-quality maternal, newborn, and child health (MNCH); family planning (FP); tuberculosis (TB); nutrition; and water, hygiene, and sanitation (WASH) interventions in these districts. With $ 400,000 in FY 2021 funds, four areas will be prioritized: consolidating the high-impact, evidence-based interventions; strengthening community-level interventions to increase demand and uptake of quality health services; health system strengthening to improve health services; and strengthening health information systems including data collection, completeness, and utilization. .To ensure continuation of services in the current COVID-19 pandemic, RHITES-SW will align its interventions and responses, including COVID-19 vaccine rollout, based on the Ugandan Ministry of Health guidelines. This will include targeted provision of personal protective equipment for service providers and beneficiaries of MNCH, FP, TB, and nutrition services..RHITES-SW will engage with all stakeholders and beneficiaries to identify, plan, and implement local solutions to health challenges. RHITES-SW will promote commitment and capacity to provide high-quality health services..
